Laboratory report LT-2020-044 - chloride and drying study, AF-12
Purpose: investigate two complaints of under-film corrosion on AF-12 coated steel
Chloride content of 20 production batches: 380-420 ppm; nearly all of it comes from the
ammonium chloride addition in the recipe.
Laboratory batches with and without ammonium chloride: dry-to-touch 3 h 10 min vs 3 h
05 min; through-dry 8 h for both. Storage 8 weeks at 40 °C: no viscosity increase in
Viscosity measured 0 h and 12 h after letdown on the same 20 production batches: no
Comments: ammonium chloride has no measurable effect on drying. Chloride above 300
ppm can contribute to under-film corrosion on steel.
